import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert columns that are stored as text but represent numbers
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Standardize sex labels (case‑insensitive)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower() if df['sex'].dtype == 'object' else df['sex']
    # Remove rows with out‑of‑range values (according to the rules)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Average body mass per species
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
